videos.description: Love a Child is a nonprofit Christian humanitarian organization that runs the Love a Child Orphanage in Haiti, where the organization's founders, Bobby and Sherry Burnette, live. Love a Child also runs 13 schools at which more than 5,000 children are educated and fed daily. The "Love a Child" TV program invites viewers to partake in the Burnettes' journey as they take viewers all over Haiti, showing them the Love a Child mission. The show also acts as a fundraiser for the mission, allowing viewers to donate to the cause.
